dslRule:
<!id: prefer-valueOf-for-wrappers>
<!description: Replace primitive wrapper constructors with their static valueOf factory methods for improved performance (caching) and to avoid deprecated API usage.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: performance, modern-java>
<!map WRAPPER_TYPES: "java.lang.Long" => "java.lang.Long", "java.lang.Integer" => "java.lang.Integer", "java.lang.Double" => "java.lang.Double", "java.lang.Float" => "java.lang.Float", "java.lang.Character" => "java.lang.Character">

new #{WRAPPER_TYPES}( $arg )
=>
#{WRAPPER_TYPES_VALUE}.valueOf( $arg )
;;
summary: Replace primitive wrapper constructors with valueOf factory methods.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
